notes:
Inbound from marketing signup (self-serve). Uses EasyAnswer as a lightweight support automation layer for 2 mid-market SaaS customers; trying to cut agent time on Tier-1 tickets. Interested in Hosted API for quick integration and cost control.
- Primary ask: ticket summarization + structured JSON output for downstream systems (priority, category, suggested reply).
- Wants tool-calling hooks to trigger internal ticket updates and look up customer context (account_id, plan).
- Latency: batch responses under 200ms avg for short summaries; acceptable to stream for longer generation.
- Cost sensitivity: medium — pref to keep per-ticket cost < $0.05.
- Security: SOC2 required; will request attestation. SSO for team, audit logging required.
- Quote from CPO on intro call: "If we can get reliable structured outputs and simple tool-calls, we can remove ~30% of repetitive agent replies."
- Early demo looked good; developer wants to try self-serve keys + sample payloads.
- Prefer public cloud (no VPC/on-prem for now).
